resource: Eligible Characters, and separately ranked accounts, of one World highscore cut
unit: rows per source of one World cut
allocation_impact: The job reads every source in keyset pages of at most 1,000 rows (CharacterId or account order) inside its one repeatable-read cut and holds at most 50,001 rows of one source; one row above the bound refuses the whole cut (SnapshotError::CapacityExceeded), publishes nothing and keeps the previous snapshots. One sort per category serves all six filter lists. The cut never truncates a source, which would falsify global ranks.
boundary_tests: max: a cut of exactly its bound of eligible Characters, or of ranked accounts, read in pages smaller than the cut publishes the same lists as the registered cut
max+1: one eligible Character or one ranked account above the bound refuses the cut and keeps the current snapshots and rows
notes: HIGHSCORES-0 §4 and §5. The brief names no World size; the bound keeps a full cut inside the 2-second Root pass deadline (PARITY_PENDING). Registered by RANK-1 (HS-1).
